title: Models registry
description: data/registry/models.json: the only model keys (DATA-PIPELINE §4). Name resolution (no substring or fuzzy match): a model-api-id fact carries a namespace. With a route id: strip once the longest of that route's name_prefixes the value starts with, then match exactly (case-sensitive) the names registered under that namespace serving at the run date; in a namespace whose route has names_case_insensitive (the Hugging Face namespace `huggingface`, repository ids 'Org/Name'), the match is case-insensitive (casefold), and the identity check compares those names casefolded. With `prefix`: the value's head up to the first '/' plus the '/' is looked up (case-insensitive) among the routes' name_prefixes; found → that route, as above; not found → route unknown: the value after the head, then the whole value, are matched in every candidate route's namespace (routes serving the model at the run date, the maker's API always included); exactly one key must result, else not established. A model-name fact matches a display name under N: NFKC, casefold, '_' '-' ':' '/' as spaces, spaces collapsed, the leading maker spellings (vocab maker x-terms.display_prefixes: 'Anthropic', 'Claude'…) dropped. A label that carries the configuration ('Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 low') is not a model-name fact. Build checks (validate.py): two keys of one maker serving one API id over overlapping intervals, or with identical display names, fail; solo only alone; defaults, selects and conversions within the model's configurations.

released.description: Release (datetime when known), from the maker (release post, model card, API reference).

line.description: The key this model is a build / mode of (lqm LINE), or null.

configurations.description: The configurations the model offers (DATA-PIPELINE §4); [solo] only for a single-configuration model. Empty: the model's configurations are not established (a doubt: every measure of it gets out:effort-not-established; registry fix, 26 Oct 2026, grok-4.20-multi-agent).

items.description: One configuration the model offers, dated.

served.description: itself: served as itself; converted: the maker converts it (see conversions; a converted level goes through the route chain, DATA-PIPELINE §5.1 step 6).

budget_max.description: For think-<budget>: largest accepted budget (tokens), or null when bounded only by max_tokens.

name.description: The API id or display name, verbatim.

serves.description: When this name served this key (the maker's own dates: release, redirect, shutdown).

selects.description: The configuration this name selects (deepseek-chat → nothink, a -thinking id → think), or null.

route.description: The namespace of the name: the route whose ids it belongs to (null = the maker's API). An OpenRouter slug ('anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5') is registered under openrouter; the maker's id ('claude-haiku-4-5') under null. A Hugging Face repository id ('Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B') is registered under huggingface (matched case-insensitively).

default.description: The configuration a call with no setting gets (on the maker's API), dated by its evidence.

conversions.description: Conversions requested → served, per route, dated.

items.description: A maker conversion requested → served (dated: decision C, conversions only when dated).

route.description: Route where the conversion happens (maker-api for the maker's own).

requested.description: Requested level or setting, verbatim configuration id where it is one.
